messages:
Maya Patel: heads-up on KairoX onboarding. their nightly bulk imports are causing p95/p99 latency drift during 01:00-04:00 local. seeing ~1s tail spikes on heavy backfills.
Priya Rao: thanks Maya. any seq_len distribution? likely long-context causing KV churn.
Maya Patel: quick histogram: 78% at 2-4k tokens, 18% at 6-10k, ~4% >12k. cache gets thrashed during window.
Liam Chen: short-term options: (A) run int8 quant profile for import route; (B) time-windowed routing to a dedicated pool using gptx-medium; (C) combine both + pre-spin warmup.
Ruth Kim (KairoX): our priority is reliability — we can accept a small model swap if quality stays intact. prefer a staged test first.
Priya Rao: propose canary plan: 5% of import traffic -> gptx-medium + int8 for 24h. measure p50/p95/p99, token cost delta, and run a 3k-sample quality eval.
Liam Chen: I'll add an autoscale rule to pre-warm 2 GPUs 20m before 01:00 and cap concurrent long-context slots to avoid noisy neighbors.
Maya Patel: draft routing snippet for Console (paste as-is):
```json
{"match":{"meta.job":"bulk_import"},"route":{"pool":"kairox-dedicated","time_window":"01:00-04:00","fallback":"hosted-us"},"transform":{"model_override":"gptx-medium","quant_profile":"int8-stable"}}
```
Ruth Kim: sounds good. we'll approve a 5% canary and review. thanks for the proactive work — this helps our renewal confidence.
ops-bot: Task created: CS-2422 "KairoX import canary + int8 route" - https://console.redwood.ai/tasks/CS-2422
Maya Patel: next steps: (1) Priya enable draft route (disabled) in Console; (2) Liam configures autoscale/warmup; (3) enable 5% canary for 24h, collect metrics & eval; (4) review on enablement call tomorrow 10:30 PT. I'll note renewal watch in the account playbook.
Priya Rao: dropping the draft route and an eval checklist into the shared doc now.
Maya Patel: I'll post canary results here after 24h. white_check_mark
